title: Incorrect lock property usage
detail: The code checks `self._export_lock.locked` which is a method, not a property, so the condition is always truthy and the branch that should run when the lock is free never executes.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: The lock acquisition is not awaited, so the code may proceed before the lock is actually acquired, causing race conditions.
note: The un-awaited acquire on line 967 is the PR's deliberate free-lock path.

title: Missing await on deferred lock acquisition
detail: The deferred returned by `self._export_lock.acquire()` is not awaited, so the lock may not be acquired before proceeding.
note: Describes the planted dropped await on the lock.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html property
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, causing the property to report the opposite of the intended value.
